profile.headline: Software Engineer SRE @ General Motors
profile.summary:
Driven Backend Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in backend and full-stack development. I help companies build scalable, high-performance systems by optimizing infrastructure, automating workflows, and reducing operational bottlenecks.

Some examples include:

-Reduced QA cycle time by 1 full workday by developing a Python-based test automation suite with overnight stress testing
-Decreased system crashes by 33% by optimizing memory usage in distributed C++ modules for connected vehicle platforms
-Delivered 12+ production releases in 6 months post-SoRP, maintaining 80%+ test coverage and ensuring consistent, on-time deployments
-Mentored two interns and scaled an internal tracking tool, boosting module tracking efficiency by 50% across engineering teams
-Represented LG Electronics at CES 2025, demoing next-gen telematics solutions on a global stage
-Rebuilding a church website using React, with a focus on maintainability and reducing manual HTML edits

I get excited about opportunities where I can tackle scaling challenges, improve backend performance, and contribute to distributed system design—especially in teams that value engineering ownership, thoughtful code quality, and fast, iterative development cycles.

I'm currently looking for software engineering opportunities in New York City. Having previously lived near Philadelphia, I’m excited to return to the East Coast—especially to NYC, a city I’ve long admired for its energy, innovation, and thriving tech community.

Feel free to connect or reach out at thkimsea@gmail.com!

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for General Motors' Telematics Control Unit, supporting connected vehicle features

Responsibilities:
-Improved system throughput and reduced resource bottlenecks via low-level performance tuning and memory profiling	
-Streamlined software testing workflows and enhanced regression test efficiency with Python and shell scripting
-Collaborated in an Agile SCRUM environment using JIRA, Confluence, and OpenGrok

Key Achievements:
-Minimized memory usage by 20% by engineering optimized backend modules within a distributed system, reducing crash frequency by 33% and significantly improving runtime stability
-Reduced QA cycle time by 1 full workday by developing an automated testing suite, enabling overnight stress testing and minimizing human errors
-Delivered 12+ production releases in 6 months by managing CI/CD pipelines post-SoRP, maintaining 80%+ test coverage, ensuring smooth deployments and on-time delivery under strict automotive timelines
-Mentored two interns in enhancing an internal tool, leading to broader cross-team adoption and a 50% increase in module tracking efficiency by reducing manual steps and scaling usability across engineering teams
-Represented LG at CES 2025, delivering live demos of next-gen telematics innovations and strengthening brand presence at a global tech convention
positions.insights: Integration Engineering, System Integration and +25 skills

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed tools to streamline the development cycle of the platform, supporting over 100 engineers

Responsibilities:
-Analyzed system logs to identify root causes of issues and support debugging efforts
Documented software defects and validation results, improving issue tracking and communication
-Gained experience navigating collaboration between OEMs and tier-1 suppliers

Key Achievements:	 	          	      
-Improved data tracking accuracy by 40% by developing an internal organizational tool that efficiently sorted telematics units by device specifications and deployment parameters
-Accelerated debugging by 25% by building a real-time log filtering tool that helped engineers quickly isolate relevant system events
-Maintained high product quality and stability by executing comprehensive regression tests on software releases, resolving critical bugs prior to deployment
positions.insights: Software Project Management, Python (Programming Language) and +11 skills

projects.title: Living Grace Ministry (Church) Website
projects.description: Took initiative to redesign and modernize Living Grace Ministry’s website, originally built over 10 years ago. Rebuilt the site from the ground up using React, Vite, Express.js, and Google APIs to improve performance, responsiveness, and maintainability, while preserving the church’s visual identity and content structure.
